scenario: login and account check on the dreamina-canvas CLI
description: Confirms that the authorization workflow follows the guide's five-step login flow, selects the right auth subcommand per environment (TTY login vs non-interactive plus device-code wait), verifies with auth account as the only trusted login evidence, and delegates credential-security internals to dreamina-canvas-cli-auth.
expectations: The five-step flow ends with auth account as the login self-check
Agent environments use --non-interactive auth login plus auth wait --device-code; login is never polled in a loop
auth status is never trusted alone as proof of login; auth account is the server-side truth
auth refresh is only called inside the refresh window
Tokens, cookies, and device codes are never persisted or logged
